name: wmkf_finalwriteupreviewacknowledgement
description: Latest version-aware review acknowledgement by one staff reviewer for one Final Writeup Request Document. This is neutral tracking, not approval, compliance, or document lifecycle state.

primaryNameAttribute.description: Synthetic display name for the Final Writeup and reviewer acknowledgement pair.
